profile.headline: Worldwide Developer
profile.summary:
I develop and design creative experiences to help professionals, students, and everyday people as they walk out their purpose.

Let me know how I can serve if you are in need of development services 🖖🏾🚀, just find me @jarmellj on the internet somewhere ✌🏾

positions.title: Web Developer/Designer
positions.description:
This   is   a   self-started   business   in   which   I   develop   applications   for   small   business   customers.   Work   includes   full   stack development   from   the   backend   to   frontend,   with   custom   solutions   provided   as   needed   to   build   websites   and   mobile applications   for   iOS   and   Android.

● Working   in   a   creative   process   that   allows   me   to   stay   up   to   date   with   latest   technologies   and   tools   while   providing solutions   for   mobile   applications,   e-commerce   systems,   custom   frameworks,   content   management   tools,   personal portfolios,   and   more.

● Technical   Tools   Used:   PHP,   JavaScript,   AngularJS,   BackboneJS,   React,   HTML,   MySQL,   SOAP,   REST,   and more.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Development   on   backend   and   frontend   of application solutions   for   a   various   wifi   management   tools   that   allows   internal   users   and customers   to   manage   and   monitor   the   network   for   their   business.

● Worked   in   an   Agile   /   Scrum   process   with   team   sizes   that   varied   between   4-8   members.

● Did   development   on   legacy   applications   to   update   them   with   new   UI   /   UX,   as   well   as   adding   performance improvements   and   new   features   on   backend.   Also   implemented   a   single   sign-on   authentication   /   authorization solution   for   these   applications   using   OIM   (Oracle   Identity   Manager).

● Led   an   offshore   team   of   developers   to   oversee   code   quality,   code   structure,   and   development   planning   for   new features.

● Assisted   in   the   architecture   /   design   planning   for   new   a   solution   that   allows   customers   to   access   REST/SOAP API’s   and   to   support   wifi   management   for   small   business   customers.   I   currently   develop   on   this   application.

● Technical   Tools   Used:   Main   tools   used   include   Java,   SPRING   Framework,   Hibernate,   Maven,   Oracle,   Javascript   ( some   jQuery   &   AngularJS   ),   CSS,   HTML,   SOAP,   REST,   and   more.

positions.title: Web Developer/Database Intern
positions.description: Worked on the development analyst team to review quality of code, QA features, and to shadow the planning of new application features and design schemes. Technical tools included: PHP, Javascript, & MySQL

positions.title: Internship
positions.description: Worked as an intern to shadow the engineering team on backend development for the business logic behind the new bank website. Assisted in development on frontend pages for the bank website as well. Technologies tools included: JAVA, SPRING Framework, Oracle, CSS, HTML.

projects.title: Nutastic Desginz
projects.description: The key to creating great websites, brands, designs and other products comes through understanding the client and the end user. It takes a unique set of skills as well as knowledge, hard work, dedication and passion to make great ideas come to life. We aim to provide you with a creative solution that combines amazing visual design and a great user experience together to bring you something NU!
